fallthrough.justification: Usually a terminal call to a noreturn callee; real fallthrough (e.g. bzero into memset) must stay rejected.
fallthrough.action: keep real fallthrough out; otherwise triage via HANDOFF

it-transfer.justification: Predicated return or branch inside an IT block; unsafe to move until modeled.
it-transfer.action: unsupported IT shape: triage via HANDOFF

cfg-crash.justification: Not justified: crash on an IT-predicated conditional tail call.

pc-write.justification: Exception-return or computed PC write; vectors and early setup stay in place permanently.

pc-read.justification: Reads the PC as data; startup runs before the MMU and must not move. ADR to an inline switch table is supportable.
